about_short_description.short_description: MyStudies.com is an EdTech comapny that provides online academic support to students from middle school to MBA, in over 80 subjects.

product.name: Custom Academic Writing Service
product.description: Provides tailored writing assistance for academic documents across over 80 subjects, from middle school to doctoral level.

product.name: Thesis and Dissertation Writing Service
product.description: Supports students in writing complete or partial theses and dissertations with dedicated tutors, ensuring adherence to academic methodology.

product.name: Academic Paper Correction and Improvement
product.description: Offers correction and enhancement of academic documents, including proofreading, content improvement, and formatting adjustments.

product.name: Detailed Academic Outline Creation
product.description: Creates customized detailed outlines and plans for academic documents to assist students in organizing their work effectively.
